First create a book as your workspace, then work through ideas with the writing agent. The title becomes the directory name; an existing directory is rejected by the server.

Writing, story and chat all need a working language model. Add a connection (provider, API base, API key), then add a model.
Denova organizes chapters, lore, versions and interactive stories per book. Create one to start writing.
The first-chapter request will be prefilled for you. Edit it and send it yourself; nothing is sent automatically.

Let us start a new book together: read ideas.md and CREATOR.md first, then work through premise, genre, conflict, world, characters and writing rules through conversation. Ask when information is missing and keep interim conclusions in ideas.md. For now do not create outlines, chapters or lore entries.

Create the first chapter markdown for %1$s with an opening that can keep growing. Focus on the opening scene, the protagonist state and the first suspense; keep the body around 800-1200 words and write it under chapters/. Summarize which files you created or changed.
